input.command:
while true; do
  count=$(ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o ConnectTimeout=10 root@cqa1-22115 'ls /root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache/google/gemma-2-27b/model-*.safetensors 2>/dev/null | wc -l' 2>/dev/null || echo "SSH_FAIL")
  alive=$(ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o ConnectTimeout=10 root@cqa1-22115 'ps -p 16339 -o pid= 2>/dev/null && echo "ALIVE" || echo "DEAD"' 2>/dev/null || echo "SSH_FAIL")
  echo "shards=$count pid=$alive"
  if [ "$count" = "24" ]; then
    echo "DOWNLOAD_COMPLETE"
    break
  fi
  if echo "$alive" | grep -q "DEAD"; then
    echo "PID_DEAD_shards=$count"
    break
  fi
  sleep 120
done
